title: OmicsLM: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-Sample Omics Reasoning

transformation_chain_verbatim: rendered in a standardized conversational format via a dynamic templating engine
injects omics placeholders into textual prompts
input_routes.evidence_quote: injects omics placeholders into textual prompts;

input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: single-cell and bulk transcriptomic profiles as a continuous modality
transformation_chain_verbatim: align all expression profiles to a fixed human gene panel of 19,260 genes
concatenate a one-dimensional input-scale indicator, the normalized expression vector, a 512-dimensional Funomics T0 embedding, and a 768-dimensional embedding from Geneformer-V2104M
apply a trainable affine projection into the LLM token-embedding space
transformation_chain_normalized: affine projection into LLM embedding space
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: replacing designated modality placeholders with these projected embeddings
input_routes.evidence_quote: OmicsLM represents each transcriptomic profile as a compact continuous representation within the LLM context.

input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: multiple biological samples interleaved in one prompt
transformation_chain_verbatim: map each profile to a continuous vector
project each vector into the LLM token-embedding space
insert each profile at a designated <omics> position in the input sequence
interleave multiple profiles with natural-language instructions
input_routes.model_visible_form_verbatim: multiple projected omics embeddings in one prompt
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: <omics> placeholder token(s) interleaved in one prompt
input_routes.evidence_quote: allowing multiple profiles to be interleaved in one prompt
input_routes.uncertainty: Composite multi-profile route; kept as one accepted route because the paper describes the mechanism as interleaved profiles in a single prompt.

transformation_chain_verbatim: augment the base tokenizer with canonical human gene symbols used for the 19,260-gene expression panel
initialize new token embeddings from the original subword token embeddings
treat gene names as atomic tokens during instruction tuning
input_routes.evidence_quote: augment the base tokenizer with the same canonical human gene symbols
input_routes.uncertainty: Tokenizer augmentation is the mechanism; classified here as text-native because the model consumes gene symbols as atomic tokens.

input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: protein questions covering subcellular locations, protein functions, and enzymatic properties
transformation_chain_verbatim: downloaded the manually reviewed Swiss-Prot flat file
filtered it to human proteins only
extracted identity fields, functional descriptions, controlled-vocabulary keywords, subcellular localization, and protein class annotations
rendered as natural-language protein QA tasks
input_routes.evidence_quote: protein questions covering subcellular locations, protein functions, and enzymatic properties
